summary: Firefox updated its FFmpeg media stack to 9.0.1 and made decoder and encoder backends more reliable across Android and Linux. This includes better H.264 profile and level handling, correctly sized Android frames, safer Vulkan Video device and DMA-BUF management, and checks for malformed recovery metadata. MediaCapabilities codec checks now wait for remote-process support, while protected-media startup can request the correct trust authority for clear lead video streams.
